claim_scope: All odd finite Kleene chains with the exact (MK), (Pos), and (Con) axioms; all normal and center-preserving subfamilies. Counts, center-defect proportions and conditional geometric limit.
integrity: Self-reviewed; no independent audit or independent validation. A symbolic proof and a reproducible finite checker are supplied.
scientific_limitations: The normal-form identity specializes the previously published centered equation and is not claimed independently new.
No theorem for even chains, arbitrary nonchain algebras, or additional modalities.
Finite computations corroborate but do not prove the all-size statements.
Historical priority beyond inspected sources has not been established.
title: Central-binomial census and geometric center-defect law for modal Kleene chains
